methodology: Driven via plain HTTP POST (curl, not WebFetch -- WebFetch's HTML-to-markdown conversion strips the raw hidden ASP.NET fields needed to replay the postback) against the classic __doPostBack/__VIEWSTATE WebForms flow: (1) GET https://ratecalculator.fnf.com/?ID=CTIC&state=AR to capture __VIEWSTATE/__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR/__EVENTVALIDATION/SessionId and confirm AR is in the state list (all 75 AR counties enumerated in ddlCounty, confirming AR IS a supported state for this tool, unlike Old Republic's ortconline.com); (2) POST ddlCounty=pulaski + ddlUnderwriters=cti (Chicago Title) + txtPolicyDate=today + btnGeneralNext=Next as a single combined form resubmission (a separate __EVENTTARGET postback for the dropdowns individually was tried first and worked too, but is not required -- one full-form resubmission with the new dropdown values succeeds directly, simpler than the condensed recipe implied); (3) POST __EVENTTARGET=...TranType$ddl with TranType$ddl=PropertyPurchase to reveal the Purchase Amount field (this dropdown truly is autopostback-only, must be its own __EVENTTARGET); (4) POST __EVENTTARGET=...AmountPurchase$txt with AmountPurchase$txt=500000 to reveal the Loan Amount field; (5) POST __EVENTTARGET=...AmountLoan1$txt with AmountLoan1$txt=400000 to advance to the Endorsements page; (6) POST btnFinish=Finish for the final Rate Summary. methodology: Harvested via Stewart's discoverable `/api/SRC/*` JSON REST API (stewartratecalculator.com), driven entirely by plain HTTP GET/POST (Python requests.Session(), cookie jar) with no browser/JS execution and no personal-data fields, replaying the full recipe documented in this project's CALCULATORS.md (2026-08-14 'SOLVED' entry): GET the LoanEstimate/Netsheet page to scrape a fresh antiforgery cookie + __RequestVerificationToken; GET /api/SRC/propertysearch to resolve the county FIPS code and a default zip; GET /api/SRC/providers to find the county's real settlement office(s) (used to set ProviderID on the QuoteType=3 flow so the itemized settlement-fee list is populated -- an empty ProviderID silently returns a null itemized list); GET /api/SRC/statesettings and /api/SRC/ernstlookup for state-level defaults; build the QuoteRequestRoot JSON by hand (Owner's Policy $500,000 / Lender's Policy $400,000, BASIC coverage, standard Sale/Purchase with Mortgage transaction); POST /api/SRC/quote twice -- QuoteType=2 (Netsheet, pageBuyerSeller=seller) for Recording/CFPB2015 transfer-tax figures, and QuoteType=3 (LoanEstimate, pageBuyerSeller=buyer, IsCalculatePremium=True, IsCalculateTitleServiceFee=True) for the itemized Pricing.TitleServiceFee.ItemizedTitleServiceFeeList settlement-fee line items. One new gotcha found and fixed this session: stewartratecalculator.com's bare apex domain 301-redirects every POST to the www subdomain, and that redirect's response body hangs indefinitely on this sandbox's proxied connection (a 30s+ read timeout with 0 bytes received) -- fixed by targeting https://www.stewartratecalculator.com directly, skipping the apex redirect entirely; this is an environment/proxy artifact, not a sign the endpoint is blocked. Also confirmed the documented /api/SRC/providers gotcha firsthand: for a single-provider county the response's `Provider` field is a bare object, not a one-element list -- must be normalized before indexing or ProviderID silently stays empty and every itemized-fee list comes back null (looks exactly like a genuine empty result).
